This CD-ROM is divided into 15 tutorial modules that explore concepts that are often difficult for introductory psychology students. Among the topics covered are psychological research, the biological foundations of behavior, sensation and perception, states of consciousness, learning, cognition, emotion, personality, abnormal behavior and its treatment and social psychology.
